evals.prompt: Plan a local recreation of a supplied product page in our existing Svelte project. Scope: one page and a working local image gallery, no checkout. No browsing is available in this test. Explain the approach and limits in 120 words; no tools.
evals.expected_output: A scoped, evidence-grounded response satisfying the listed expectations.
expectations: Preserves Svelte, one-page gallery scope and excludes checkout.
Requires inspection before claiming faithful recreation.
Does not claim a source capture or completed app.

evals.prompt: We want to recreate an account dashboard from a live URL. The browser currently shows a login wall; screenshots from behind login are unavailable. Give the appropriate concise response without tools; do not invent the dashboard.
evals.expected_output: A scoped, evidence-grounded response satisfying the listed expectations.
expectations: Does not treat login page as the requested dashboard.
Does not claim faithful implementation or request credentials in chat.

evals.prompt: Make a new landing page inspired by example.com, with our own brand and product. We explicitly want a redesign, not a copy. Explain the appropriate next step in under 100 words, no tools.
evals.expected_output: A scoped, evidence-grounded response satisfying the listed expectations.
expectations: Recognizes a design request rather than faithful cloning.
Preserves new brand and product direction.
Does not demand exact source reproduction.
